scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w app
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w api
scripts.dev:v1: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:v1 -w api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w web
